spec.assertion: it.skip — no incoming-attack trigger primitive; the scope-lock boss deals no damage to allies, so the 20-attack threshold can never accrue. Trigger identity is unmodelable, so any uptime is invented.

Stripping skill1 leaves every unit's total byte-identical (noS1.tot toEqual base.tot). Reload speed IS damage (it gates shots fired), so this fails under the nearest-wrong model where the unmodelable attacked-20-times trigger is replaced by a passive/interval stand-in and the whole team gets buffed off an invented cadence. Scope guard: if any reloadSpeedPct 36.96 buff IS emitted it must reach ≥4 distinct targetSlugs (all allies), and reloadSpeedPct must never carry 14.78 (the DEF magnitude).
defPct is engine-inert in v1, so it may be present for kit completeness but must not move damage (same strip test), and must never appear at 36.96 (swap check) nor under any offensive stat.
it.skip — the hitCount:120 trigger is expressible but its payload (Attract/Taunt 3 sec) has no primitive and no boss-aggro model. Behaviourally covered by the skill2 strip test staying identical.
it.skip — no taunt effect kind; nothing in v1 consumes enemy targeting. Guarded by 'no damage-dealing effect kind anywhere' so it cannot be smuggled in as a proc.
it.skip — allies take no damage in v1, so this header never fires. Load-bearing: it gates the burst-CDR below.
it.skip — no indomitability primitive and an unreachable trigger. Also gates the burst's Incoming Healing block.

Structural: no burstCdr effect may ride a reachable trigger (passive/burstCast/fullBurstEnter/shotFired/hitCount/interval/…). Behavioural: stripping skill2 is byte-identical, and the sensitivity probe (a passive allies burstCdr 11.58) provably DOES change totals — so the equality is not vacuous. Nearest-wrong: treating the CDR as unconditional, which shortens every rotation and adds full bursts (makima is Burst II, cd 20s → 8.42s).

committed.hasPierce !== true, plus a gainPierce effect with durationSec 10 on a burst-slot block with target self and trigger burstCast. Fails under (a) the static whole-fight hasPierce flag (tags all 180s of shots, not a 10s window) and (b) a fullBurstEnter key, which in this two-Burst-II comp would grant Pierce on rotations makima never casts.

spec.kitLine: Recover 34.02% of atk dmg as HP
spec.assertion: No flatDamage/dot/hitRepeat/storedHit/stackedNuke anywhere in the override, and no buffApply carrying 34.02. Fails under the nearest-wrong reading of lifesteal as a damage rider (a per-shot flatDamage 34.02 probe demonstrably moves her total, so the inertness assertion is non-vacuous). A `heal` with ticks (self-targeted) would be acceptable-and-inert here; it fires no consumer in this comp.
it.skip — no StatKey for incoming healing and the indomitability gate is unreachable. Guarded live by 'no buffApply carries 41.02'.

fixtures: controlComp('makima', true) only — makima is Burst II, so the comp's Burst I + Burst II + Burst III chain is what makes her burst castable at all, and the fixed second Burst III (helm) is kept so full bursts actually fire (dropping it risks zero full bursts). Deterministic, no seed. Six hoisted 180s runs: base; skill2+burst stripped; skill1 stripped; +passive allies burstCdr 11.58 (sensitivity); +shotFired flatDamage 34.02 (sensitivity); +burstCast flatDamage 400 (proves the fixture actually casts her burst, i.e. non-vacuity for every burst-slot claim). Structural assertions read the committed override via withPatchedOverride('makima', () => {}) because the kit's live claims (timed vs whole-fight Pierce, CDR gating) are damage-invisible at scope lock — no unit in this comp carries a Pierce Damage ▲ buff and pierceDamagePct is documented inert in v1.
gaps: skill1 'Activates when attacked 20 times' — no incoming-attack trigger primitive; the scope-lock boss deals no damage to allies, so the threshold never accrues (this makes the 36.96% ally Reload Speed grant measurement-gated rather than merely inert: reload speed is real damage, so modeling it needs a measured duty cycle, not an invented cadence)
skill2 'Attract: Taunt all enemies for 3 sec' — no taunt effect kind and no boss-aggro model; only the hitCount:120 trigger half is expressible
skill2 'Gain indomitability for 7 sec / 1 time per battle' — no indomitability primitive and its lethal-damage trigger cannot fire in v1
burst 'Recover 34.02% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec' — no HP pool; the only observable payload would be recovery events for an on-heal consumer, and this comp has none
burst 'Incoming healing ▲ 41.02% for 10 sec' — no StatKey for incoming healing, and the indomitability gate it sits behind is unreachable

Fixture-dependency flagged: the burstCast sensitivity probe doubles as the non-vacuity check for every burst-slot assertion; if makima never wins a Burst II slot against the fixed Burst II in controlComp, that probe goes RED and the Pierce assertions must be re-run on a comp where she is the sole Burst II
